name: nogap
description: Local skills for detecting, repairing, verifying, and coordinating reader-facing gaps in rigorous explanations.

interface.shortDescription: Find and repair reasoning gaps and reader-friction in rigorous explanations.
interface.longDescription: Nogap packages separate skills for scanning explanatory artifacts, filling substantial reasoning gaps, detecting Japanese prose friction, verifying repairs, and coordinating multi-artifact repair work.
interface.defaultPrompt: Review this artifact for reasoning gaps and reader-friction, then repair the ones that matter.
